title: First-variable canonical tensor shift commutes with reassociation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with $D(\mathcal O_X)$, its recorded K-flat tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and its canonical two-variable tensor shifts [def-sc-scheme-canonical-tensor-shift]. For $A,K,M$ in this derived category and $n\in\mathbb Z$, write $s_B(n)_A:A[n]\otimes B\to(A\otimes B)[n]$ for the canonical first-variable shift comparison. Then $s_{K\otimes M}(n)_A\circ\alpha_{A,K,M}^{-1}[n]=\alpha_{A[n],K,M}^{-1}\circ(s_K(n)_A\otimes\mathrm{id}_M)\circ s_M(n)_{A\otimes K}$, with composites read from left to right as in Lean. No unitors or translated-unit comparison occur in this assertion.

source.place: Canonical K-flat total tensor translation; translated-unit calculation of the parent plan

proof.text: For every derived object choose a K-flat resolution of a representing complex; localization inverts its augmentation and gives an isomorphism Q(P) to that object. Apply the shift-one reassociation calculation at three such representatives.

Regard inverse reassociation as (tensorRightTensor K M).hom. Transport its shift-one square in A by naturality and cancellation of an isomorphism. Transport in M and K using associator naturality and the canonical tensor-morphism shift squares from CommShift₂Int. The Lean helpers explicitly perform this transport without additional assumptions on the associator.

The zero square is CommShiftCore.zero. Expand the addition square for (-1)+1, cancel both invertible comparisons, and use faithfulness of shift by one to obtain the minus-one square. CommShiftCore.add and integer induction then give every integer shift. Evaluate this square at A and unfold the composite tensorRight shifts.

proof_origin.place: K-flat localization followed by explicit naturality transport in three factors and integer-shift induction, as written in Lean by C4.

The associator for derived tensor products commutes with shifting the first tensor factor

from.place: Triple tensor totalization reassociation step of lem-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-associativity

lean.statement:
theorem schemeCanonicalTensorShift_associator (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (A K M : schemeDerivedCategory X) (n : ℤ) :
    letI := schemeCanonicalTensorShift X
    letI : ∀ B : schemeDerivedCategory X, (tensorRight B).CommShift ℤ :=
      fun B ↦ Functor.CommShift₂.commShiftFlipObj (h := .int) B
    ((tensorRight (K ⊗ M)).commShiftIso n).hom.app A ≫ (α_ A K M).inv⟦n⟧' =
      (α_ (A⟦n⟧) K M).inv ≫
        (((tensorRight K).commShiftIso n).hom.app A) ▷ M ≫
        ((tensorRight M).commShiftIso n).hom.app (A ⊗ K)
